Class CoreAPI

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.CoreAPI
public final class CoreAPI extends Object
The version of Core's API, for plugins built on it. Other plugins depend on what is listed here staying as it is: things are added (and API_VERSION goes up), never changed or removed.

The stable API (safe to build on):

  • com.atomictempest.core: AdminLog, Announcements, BlockFacing, Boosts, ChatPrefix, CoinEffects, CraftRestrictions, Currency, Editions, HudLines, ItemIcons, JsonFiles, Lang, Leaderboards, Mailbox, Perks, Placeholders, PlayerActions, PlayLimits, RateLimit, Themes, Registrations, ReservedDrops, SafeFiles, WalletEvents and this class;
  • com.atomictempest.core.economy: Economy and Economies;
  • com.atomictempest.core.help: HelpTopic and HelpTopics;
  • com.atomictempest.core.settings: CasinoSettings, Setting and SettingsTab.

Internal (may change in any release, do not use): Main and the packages command, config, listener, player and ui. 

if (CoreAPI.API_VERSION < 1) { ... }   // a Core older than the one you built against

  • Field Details

    • API_VERSION

      public static final int API_VERSION
      Goes up when something is added to the stable API.
      • 1: Core 1.0.0, everything above.
      • 2: AdminLog, RateLimit, and SettingsTab groups (tempest.admin.<group>).
      • 3: PlayLimits, the daily limit for games of chance; HudLines.compact ("12.5K"); Themes; dropdowns and item pickers in the settings menu (Setting.choice, Setting.item) and tab icons (SettingsTab.icon); ItemIcons.ids and ItemIcons.pretty.
      • 4: the Tempest board's line names and keys: HudLines.name, nameOf, keys, lineFor.
      • 5: Boosts, boosts for a while (Tempest Events), and Registrations.boost.
      • 6: Mailbox, one mailbox for every plugin (/mail), and HudLines.startOff.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

  • Method Details

    • runningVersion

      public static int runningVersion()
      The version of the Core running on the server. API_VERSION is copied into your plugin when it is compiled, so ask this to know what the installed Core has.
